description: This core course of Asian studies introduces students to modern Chinese literature and society.
It examines canonical and popular works of Chinese writings including fiction, drama,
autobiography, correspondences, and poetry from the early 20th century to the 21st century.  Films
and songs also serve as supplementary material when appropriate. Students read texts in
translation and approach them in the context of modern
